passages.text:
Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0) has been launched with an objective to provide pucca houses to 1 crore people of urban India.
PMAY-U 2.0 will provide financial assistance to 1 crore families to construct, purchase or rent a house in urban areas over a period of 5 years.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 2, Preface

passages.text:
The Scheme will be implemented through following four verticals:
Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC)
Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP)
Affordable Rental Housing (ARH)
Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS)

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 6, Background

passages.text:
EWS beneficiary to construct house on own land
Provision of land patta/ rights to the landless by States/UTs
Geo-tag the construction stages of the house by beneficiaries.
Release of instalment is linked to construction stage
Free of cost statutory approvals, if needed
Upgradation of Tenable Slums with housing and infrastructure

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 10, PMAY-U 2.0 Verticals, Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC)

passages.text:
EWS beneficiary to purchase/avail allotted houses in Apartment projects by public/ private sector agencies/ parastatal agencies
Redeemable Housing Vouchers for purchase of houses in whitelisted private sector projects
Various State Incentives to public/private projects
In-Situ Slum Redevelopment of tenable Slums or Slum Resettlement

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 10, PMAY-U 2.0 Verticals, Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP)

passages.text:
Affordable & dignified rental living spaces for urban dwellers
Model-1: Utilizing existing Government funded vacant houses by converting them into ARH under PPP mode or by public agencies.
Model-2: Construct, Operate and Maintain rental housing by Private/Public Entities for urban poor, working women, employees of Industries, Industrial Estates, Institutions and other eligible EWS/LIG families.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 10, PMAY-U 2.0 Verticals, Affordable Rental Housing (ARH)

passages.text:
Benefits of subsidy on home loans for EWS/LIG and MIG families
Max. Loan value ₹25 lakh
Max. House Value ₹35 lakh
Loan subsidy of up to ₹1.80 lakh for EWS/LIG/MIG beneficiaries
5-Yearly instalments

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 10, PMAY-U 2.0 Verticals, Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS)

passages.text: Special focus will be given to Safai Karmi, Street Vendors identified under PMSVANidhi Scheme and different artisans under Pradhan Mantri- Vishwakarma Scheme, Anganwadi workers, building and other construction workers, residents of slums/chawls and other groups identified during operation of PMAY-U 2.0.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 8, Eligibility Criteria

passages.text: Families belonging to EWS/LIG/MIG category, living in urban areas, having no pucca house anywhere in the country, are eligible to purchase or construct a house under PMAY-U 2.0. A beneficiary will be eligible for availing benefit under any one vertical of the scheme.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 8, Eligibility Criteria

passages.text: EWS households are defined as households with an annual income of up to ₹3 lakh; LIG as households with an annual income from ₹3 lakh up to ₹6 lakh; and MIG as households with an annual income from ₹6 lakh up to ₹9 lakh. States/UTs shall have the flexibility to redefine the annual income criteria of EWS as per prevailing conditions with concurrence of MoHUA.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 8, Eligibility Criteria

passages.text: The beneficiary who has been allotted house under any of the housing scheme of Central Government, State/UT Government and Local Self Government in last 20 years in urban or rural areas, shall not be eligible to seek benefit under PMAY-U 2.0.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 8, Eligibility Criteria

passages.text: A beneficiary family will comprise of husband, wife, unmarried sons and/or unmarried daughters.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 3, Things To Know, para 3

passages.text: A 'Pucca' house is defined as an all-weather dwelling unit with roof and walls made up of sturdy, modern, and durable materials like burnt bricks, stones packed with cement or lime, cement concrete, timber, Galvanized Iron (GI) sheets, asbestos sheets, machine-made tiles etc.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 3, Things To Know, para 2

passages.text: Preference under the Scheme will be given to Widows, single women, Persons with Disabilities, Senior Citizens, Transgenders, persons belonging to Scheduled Castes/ Scheduled Tribes, Minorities and other weaker and vulnerable sections of the society.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 8, Eligibility Criteria

passages.text: All eligible beneficiaries (including family members) should have an Aadhaar/ Aadhaar Virtual ID integrated with the details of beneficiaries.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 9, Eligibility Criteria

passages.text:
User would not be Eligible for the schemes in cases:
Annual Household Income is above ₹9,00,000
If the user owns a pucca house anywhere in India
If they have availed benefit under any Housing scheme of Central/State/UT government in past 20 years.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 19, Step 4 Eligibility for PMAY-U 2.0

passages.text: The houses sanctioned under PMAY-U which got curtailed by Central Sanctioning and Monitoring Committee (CSMC) after 31.12.2023 due to any reason on the recommendation of States/UTs, shall not be sanctioned in PMAY-U 2.0 to those beneficiaries.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 9, Eligibility Criteria

passages.text: A beneficiary meeting the eligibility criteria defined under the scheme may submit the application through Unified Web Portal of PMAY-U 2.0, Common Service Centre (CSC) or by visiting the concerned Urban Local Bodies/Municipalities they are residing in.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 3, Things To Know, para 1

passages.text: Interested beneficiary who wants to own a house under PMAY-U 2.0 can register herself/himself on the PMAY-U 2.0 website, wherein it is required to click on ‘Apply for PMAY-U 2.0’ tab.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 16, Applying for PMAY-U 2.0, Step 1

passages.text:
The system would successfully take the user to the Instruction of PMAY-U 2.0 page.
This page provides information about the four verticals under PMAY-U 2.0 along with annual income criteria for eligibility and permissible carpet area for each vertical.
The User is required to read and understand the instructions carefully, her/his eligibility criteria, the option to choose any one vertical out of the four verticals of PMAY-U 2,0 before availing the benefits.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 17, Step 2

passages.text:
Users are required keep the necessary documents ready before proceeding further.
To go to the next page, click on the Proceed button.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 18, Step 3

passages.text: After proceeding, the User needs to undergo the eligibility check for the scheme.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 19, Step 4

passages.text:
Once the Eligibility check is completed, the user shall give consent for Aadhaar authentication.
Users must enter their Aadhaar Number and Name exactly as provided in the Aadhaar card.
An OTP will be generated on the mobile number registered with the Aadhaar card.
Upon receiving the OTP, user shall enter the OTP and submit the same to complete the process.
Note: A single Aadhar number can be used to fill only one form.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 20, Step 5 Aadhaar Authentication

passages.text:
In case of Married Female, Husband’s Aadhar details are mandatory.
Widow: Please select Late from the dropdown menu.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 21, Step 6 Beneficiary Survey Form, Personal Details

passages.text: The system will auto-fill family member details, based on the information provided in Personal details. User can review these details, make edits, or add other family members information as required. In case of Married Male, please specify details of the wife in this section.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 22, Step 6 Beneficiary Survey Form, Details of Family Member

passages.text: The system will automatically fill the Household Category, pucca house ownership and Average Annual Household Income. Users are required to upload Income certificate (pdf file less than 200 kb), select years of stay in the town/city, and fill in the house ownership details, such as own/rent/no house. Then mention the type of house kutcha/semi-pucca/pucca; then select the type of roof from dropdown.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 23, Step 6 Beneficiary Survey Form, Household Details

passages.text: Note: For BLC projects, it is mandatory to upload the Land document for the construction site (pdf file less than 5 MB).

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 23, Step 6 Beneficiary Survey Form, BLC Address

passages.text: Users also need to enter their Present Address/Permanent Address and AHP Project Location details by entering the State, District and city details. They must mention if they have identified any AHP Project.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 28, Step 6 Beneficiary Survey Form, AHP Address

passages.text:
In the ISS Component, Users must provide Home Loan Details. If the User has already availed a Home Loan, select Yes and enter the required details.
In case the User has not yet availed for Home Loan, select No, select the State, and select five preferred PLIs. Click on save & continue.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 33, Step 6 Beneficiary Survey Form, ISS Home Loan Details

passages.text: Users must enter their active bank account number and IFSC code to generate Bank details.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 24, Step 6 Beneficiary Survey Form, Bank Details

passages.text: After the User clicks on the Final Save, she/he will not be able make any modifications. The system will generate an Application ID Number. Once the User clicks on the OK button, the system will generate an acknowledgment form mentioning that the User’s application has been successfully forwarded to the concerned Urban Local Body for verification and processing as per the guidelines of the scheme.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 25, Submitting the Survey Form (BLC)

passages.text:
On the final page, check the acknowledgment box to confirm the accuracy of the information provided and click on the Final Save button to submit the form.
Once the User clicks on the OK button, the system will generate an acknowledgment form mentioning that the application has been successfully forwarded to the concerned Primary Lending Institution i.e. Bank, Housing Finance Company etc., for verification and processing as per the guidelines of the scheme.
Users can click on Print button to either save the PDF of their application or print it.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 35, Submitting the Survey Form (ISS)

passages.text:
This section provides a step-by-step guide for applicants to log in to the Applicant Portal using their Aadhaar number.
Click on Login
Click on Applicant Login
Enter the Aadhaar Number
Name as per Aadhar Number
Click on Generate OTP
Enter OTP and Click on Submit.
The system will display the application that is submitted by the User.
Click on red Withdraw button under the Action
Your application will be withdrawn.

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; pp. 36-37, Applicant Login and withdrawal

passages.text:
Applicant's Aadhaar details (Aadhaar number, name as per Aadhaar, date of birth).
Aadhaar details of family members (Aadhaar number, name as per Aadhaar, date of birth).
Active bank account details of the applicant (account number, bank name, branch, IFSC code) linked with Aadhaar.
Income proof certificate
Caste certificate (In case of SC, ST or OBC).
Land document (In case of BLC vertical).

source.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source.locator: PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary application user manual; p. 18, Step 3 Documents Required (screenshot; read from page image)
